quote: Where the signal is a green turn arrow alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway until permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].

activation.condition: Pedestrian faces an official signal showing a sole green turn arrow.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Observe the separate governing device and retain the cited permission question for legal review.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: until permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283

obligation.description: Do not enter the highway before another device permits proceeding under the cited provision.
